content:
Lena Varga-Holm
Senior Data Engineer

[EMAIL] | [PHONE] | [LINKEDIN] | [LOCATION]

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior Data Engineer with experience owning and operating data platform ingestion, orchestration and warehouse systems. Built production streaming and CDC pipelines, modernised warehouse transformations, and improved platform performance and cost. Experienced with Python, SQL, Airflow, dbt, Kafka and Snowflake, with cloud data engineering experience across AWS and Snowflake. Mentors engineers and contributes to open-source software.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming and query languages: Python, SQL
Data platforms and warehousing: Snowflake, Redshift, AWS Glue Data Catalog
Data engineering: Airflow, dbt, Kafka, Kafka Connect, Debezium, PySpark, Great Expectations
Cloud and infrastructure: AWS MSK, AWS EMR, S3, Terraform
CI/CD and testing: GitHub Actions, pytest

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Data Engineer | Lukovac Freight Hub d.o.o. | 2022–Present
- Own ingestion and orchestration for the data platform, using Airflow, Snowflake, dbt and Kafka.
- Designed and built a shipment-event streaming pipeline processing around 30 million events per day, with end-to-end latency under two minutes at p95.
- Added a dead-letter topic and replay tooling to support reprocessing failed events without data loss.
- Migrated approximately 300 stored procedures to documented, tested dbt models; introduced incremental models and slim CI in GitHub Actions, reducing the nightly warehouse build from 5 hours 10 minutes to 1 hour 35 minutes.
- Replaced hourly full-table extracts from the orders database with Debezium CDC into Kafka, reducing replica CPU during loads from approximately 70% to 25%.
- Reduced Snowflake costs from approximately 38k/month to 24k/month in 2024 through warehouse sizing, auto-suspend and removal of unused tables.
- Participate in the data platform on-call rotation, one week in six.
- Mentor two mid-level engineers and run data platform office hours.

Data Engineer | Kovalent Pay | 2019–2022
- Developed PySpark batch jobs on AWS EMR and designed Redshift warehouse solutions.
- Worked on data quality using Great Expectations.
- Built a transaction reconciliation engine matching bank settlement files against internal ledgers; reduced finance team's manual reconciliation from around three days to four hours per month-end.

SELECTED PROJECTS AND CONTRIBUTIONS
Open-source contribution | Airflow provider package | 2023
- Fixed a pagination bug and added tests for a community Airflow provider for a SaaS CRM API; two pull requests were merged.

EDUCATION
MSc, Computer Science | Northgate Technical University
- Thesis: Incremental materialized views

CERTIFICATION
AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate | May 2024

COMMUNITY
- Teach SQL for beginners at a local women-in-tech meetup, approximately four evenings per year since 2021.
- Presented “Data contracts without the hype” at a regional data meetup in 2024.

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, focused senior-level CV with clear progression, relevant technologies, measurable outcomes, and credible production-scale examples. The strongest evidence is the 30-million-events-per-day streaming pipeline, the dbt migration, CDC implementation, warehouse build-time reduction, Snowflake cost reduction, on-call ownership, mentoring, and open-source contribution. The structure is easy to scan and the bullets generally lead with meaningful actions and results. The main content weaknesses are that data modelling is implied rather than named explicitly, query optimisation is not clearly evidenced, and several relevant technologies from the candidate material—particularly PostgreSQL and Snowpipe Streaming—are absent from the skills section. The contact fields are still placeholders, which prevents the document from being final-submission ready.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The CV uses ATS-friendly section headings, conventional reverse-chronological experience, plain text bullets, and strong keyword coverage for Python, SQL, Airflow, dbt, Kafka, Snowflake, AWS, CI/CD, data quality, CDC, and open-source contribution. Its screening probability is high for a general Senior Data Engineer or Data Platform role. ATS matching could improve by explicitly using supported terms such as data modelling, production data platform, warehouse performance optimisation, PostgreSQL, Snowpipe Streaming, and AWS cloud data engineering. The current wording 'cloud data engineering experience across AWS and Snowflake' is slightly imprecise because Snowflake is a data warehouse/platform rather than a cloud provider. No problematic graphics, tables, columns, or unusual formatting are present.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The CV aligns very well with the core role: it demonstrates designing, building, and operating a production data platform at scale; Airflow/dbt/Python/SQL experience; streaming and CDC; warehouse transformation; operational ownership; performance and cost improvement; data quality; mentoring; and an open-source contribution. AWS, EMR, MSK, S3, and Snowflake provide a credible comparable-cloud match despite no Google Cloud experience. The strongest culture matches are ownership of platform operations and on-call work, mentoring and office hours, practical simplification through dbt and CDC, and curiosity/open-source involvement. The document does not establish dimensional modelling, graph modelling, Portuguese, or direct experience with GCP, although GCP is addressed by comparable AWS experience. Query optimisation on large datasets is also not stated precisely enough; the CV shows warehouse performance and cost optimisation, but should not claim query optimisation unless the candidate can substantiate it.
critique.improvement_instructions:
CRITICAL: In the header, replace '[EMAIL] | [PHONE] | [LINKEDIN] | [LOCATION]' with the candidate's actual professional contact details before submitting. Keep the same single-line format so the document remains ATS-readable.

MINOR, HIGH-VALUE ATS IMPROVEMENTS:
1. In the Professional Summary, replace 'with cloud data engineering experience across AWS and Snowflake' with 'with AWS cloud data engineering and Snowflake data warehousing experience.' This is more technically precise while retaining supported keywords.
2. In the Professional Summary, add the supported phrase 'production data platform' to the opening sentence, for example: 'Senior Data Engineer with experience owning and operating a production data platform, ingestion systems, orchestration, and cloud data warehouses at scale.'
3. In the Technical Skills section, add 'PostgreSQL' under 'Data platforms and warehousing' or create a 'Databases and warehousing' line. PostgreSQL is supported by the candidate's Debezium CDC project.
4. In the Technical Skills section, add 'Snowpipe Streaming' under 'Data engineering' or 'Data platforms and warehousing.' It is explicitly supported by the shipment-event pipeline portfolio project.
5. In the Technical Skills section, add a truthful 'Data modelling and optimisation' category containing 'dbt models, incremental models, warehouse performance optimisation, and data quality testing.' Do not add 'dimensional modelling' or 'query optimisation' unless the candidate can substantiate those specific techniques.
6. In the Senior Data Engineer experience section under Lukovac Freight Hub, revise 'Reduced Snowflake costs from approximately 38k/month to 24k/month in 2024 through warehouse sizing, auto-suspend and removal of unused tables' to 'Optimised Snowflake warehouse sizing and auto-suspend settings and removed unused tables, reducing monthly costs from approximately 38k to 24k in 2024.' This gives the performance-optimisation evidence stronger ATS and recruiter visibility without overstating query optimisation.
7. In the Data Engineer experience section under Kovalent Pay, revise 'Developed PySpark batch jobs on AWS EMR and designed Redshift warehouse solutions' to 'Developed PySpark batch jobs on AWS EMR and designed Redshift data warehouse solutions.' If accurate, add 'including data modelling' only if the candidate can specifically describe the modelling work; do not imply dimensional modelling without evidence.
8. In the Professional Summary or Selected Projects section, explicitly mention the open-source contribution as 'contributed to an open-source Airflow provider through two merged pull requests, including a pagination fix and tests.' This is already supported and closely matches the employer's open-source-practices requirement.
critique.critical_issues: The contact information remains as placeholders ('[EMAIL] | [PHONE] | [LINKEDIN] | [LOCATION]'), so the CV is not ready for submission. Replace these placeholders with the candidate's actual details. No unsupported skills, tools, certifications, or experiences were detected in the substantive CV content.

AWS is a credible comparable cloud background for the requirement, although the document does not show Google Cloud specifically. critique.improvement_instructions:

1. Before submitting, resolve the employment-history inconsistency between this CV and the supplied original candidate information. The original cover letter states that Lena worked at Adria Retail Group for the past two years, while this CV states Senior Data Engineer at Lukovac Freight Hub from 2022–Present and Data Engineer at Kovalent Pay from 2019–2022. Verify the correct employers, dates, and responsibilities, then update the Professional Experience section and any related project entries so the complete CV is factually consistent. In the Senior Data Engineer experience section, revise “Own ingestion and orchestration for the data platform” to “Own the design, build and day-to-day operation of the production data platform’s ingestion and orchestration” if that accurately reflects the candidate's responsibilities. This closely matches the role's wording and is supported by the current ownership and on-call evidence.

For example, change “designed Redshift data warehouse solutions” to “designed Redshift cloud data warehouse solutions and developed PySpark batch jobs on AWS EMR.” Keep the existing dbt and incremental-model evidence as the factual basis for data modelling alignment.

critique.job_alignment_feedback: Alignment is strong for the central data platform responsibilities. The CV directly demonstrates designing, building, and operating a production data platform; operating a cloud data warehouse at scale; Airflow and dbt; Python and SQL; Kafka-based streaming and CDC; warehouse performance and cost optimisation; data quality testing; mentoring; and open-source practice. The AWS experience is a credible comparable-cloud match through Snowflake, Redshift, EMR, MSK, S3, Glue Data Catalog, and Terraform. The CV also supports the company's Ownership and Pace themes through on-call ownership, incident recovery tooling, performance improvements, cost reduction, and simplification of warehouse processes. Dimensional modelling is not specifically demonstrated in the candidate material, so it is a gap rather than a wording issue. Graph modelling and Portuguese are also not evidenced. The document does not explicitly show work with data scientists, analytics engineers, BI colleagues, governance rules, or access policies, although these are responsibilities rather than separately listed requirements.
critique.improvement_instructions:
CRITICAL — Before submitting, reconcile the employment history with the original candidate information. The original cover letter states that Lena worked at Adria Retail Group for approximately two years as a BI developer and migrated 60 SSIS packages to Python, while this CV states Kovalent Pay from 2019–2022 and Lukovac Freight Hub from 2022–Present. Verify the actual employers, dates, job titles, and projects against the candidate's employment records. In the Professional Experience section, retain only the verified history; if Adria Retail Group is the correct employer, replace the conflicting Kovalent/Lukovac entries with the verified experience and do not retain unsupported Lukovac or Kovalent claims. If the CV history is correct and the cover letter is outdated, update the source information so all application documents use the same verified chronology.

MINOR — After the employment history is verified, check that the Professional Summary and all experience dates remain consistent with the corrected chronology. Do not add dimensional modelling, graph modelling, Portuguese, Google Cloud, Docker, or other technologies unless the candidate can substantiate them.
critique.critical_issues: Potential factual inconsistency or hallucination requiring verification: the CV claims employment at Lukovac Freight Hub from 2022–Present and Kovalent Pay from 2019–2022, whereas the original cover letter identifies Adria Retail Group as the candidate's employer for the past two years and describes a different ETL project. The CV's Lukovac, Kovalent, project, technology, certification, and achievement claims are otherwise supported by the supplied candidate notes and portfolio, but the conflicting chronology must be resolved.
